In flight: Papyrus PR #912 (feat/listing-story-types), open at planning time. Filed so the epic shows it; the Anth.us follow-up task depends on its release.

## What it does
`types=` and `notTypes=` on listing selections (include attributes, `collection` and `tagSelect` selections): comma lists, case-insensitive, unknown keys still rejected, the page digest accounts for the filter (`include_inputs` lists only matching entries). Sites that do not use it render byte-identically.

## Files (already in the PR)
- `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/includes.py`, `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/select.py`
- `features_backend/standard-listing-story-types.feature`
- `procedures/newsroom/tests/test_standard_frontend_includes.py`, `test_standard_frontend_collections.py`
- `docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md`, `docs/home-page.md`

## Acceptance
- CI green, merged to develop, released (`npm view @anthusai/papyrus version` shows the release that contains it; record the version here).
- `::include{kind="listing" sections="articles" types="article" count="1"}` on an authored page renders the newest article even when a `page` is newer.
